title: Enforce Team Engineering Rules with Agent Hooks
competency: 01. Toolchain Setup - Project rules, hooks, guardrails, and CLI or MCP wiring
mission: Configure shared agent hooks that apply supplied team engineering rules during development.
domain: Release-workflow dashboard with existing classification behavior and a synthetic team-managed configuration fixture.
outcome: A fresh agent session blocks supplied protected edits, checks changes automatically, surfaces failures, and verifies its final source state.
seededDefects: No project-local hook setup is supplied.
Source edits do not automatically run checks.
No completion hook detects missing, failing, or outdated results.
verificationGates: Supplied editing and shell probes are denied before execution.
Allowed edits trigger native post-tool checks.
Failed changes and tools produce actionable feedback.
Completion rejects stale verification and avoids endless retries.
A fresh final session completes the summary with unchanged classifications.
Final verification validates protected inputs, application behavior, evidence consistency, and sealed artifacts.
agentWorkflow: Assess this standalone repository and its team rules.
Implement and activate project-local native hooks for one supported agent.
Exercise the supplied harmless scenarios and retain original logs.
Commit the setup, then complete the development task in a fresh session.
Record, seal, and verify the implementation and runtime evidence.
workingDeliverables: Project-local native hook configuration and handlers
Raw runtime logs and fresh-session transcript
